CodeSystem: Terminologia de Produto Medicinal Virtual (VMP) na Ontologia Brasileira de Medicamentos (OBM)

Official URL: http://www.saude.gov.br/fhir/r4/CodeSystem/BRObmVMP Version: 1.0.0-release
Standards status: Normative Maturity Level: 1 Computable Name: BRObmVMP
